main.summary: Represents a segmented transfer read operation result containing streamed payload bytes and footer metadata.

property.name: Footer
property.summary: Shared footer metadata describing the streamed payload bytes.

property.name: Payload
property.summary: Readable payload stream returned for the realized transfer range.

method.name: FinalizeFooter
method.summary: Finalize the streamed payload hash and return the completed footer metadata.
method.returns: Completed footer metadata including the final segment SHA-512.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Dispose the owned payload stream and release any underlying staged file handles.
